description.value: Ambar Surrey Dhaba is an Indian restaurant on King George Boulevard in Surrey with a broad menu spanning Punjabi classics, tandoori platters, Indo-Chinese fusion, and monster milkshakes. The kitchen draws on ten years of culinary experience and sources ingredients from local farmers' markets. It is one of two locations operated by the same team, the other being in White Rock.

address.value: 6914 King George Boulevard, Surrey, BC V3W 4Z9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at ambarsurrey.com is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (6914 King George Boulevard, Surrey) and phone (+1-604-591-8850). The site confirms takeout/online ordering and shows an extensive vegetarian menu (Veg Thali, Paneer Tikka, Hara Bhara Kebab, Chilli Paneer, etc.). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Ambar Surrey Dhaba' but the website consistently uses 'Ambar Surrey Restaurant' — slight name mismatch.
OSM community field is listed as 'Tsawwassen' but the business address is Surrey, BC — likely a data entry error in the OSM community assignment.
Website contact page lists a second Surrey phone number (+1-778-865-0005) not present in OSM.
OSM cuisine tag is 'indian' only, but the website describes the menu as blending Indian, Chinese, and Western cuisines — minor tag inaccuracy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with a confirmed address and recently verified OSM check_date of 2026-05-22. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a substantial meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a dedicated Veg Thali, Chilli Paneer, Paneer Tikka, Hara Bhara Kebab, Honey Chilli Cauliflower, Palak Paneer, and an Indo-Chinese Veg Thali, among other vegetarian items

wow_evidence: one of two locations operated by the same team, the other being in White Rock
